We need to generate test class for lowest(int) method. Use similar style as existing tests but using JUnit5 (JUnit Jupiter). Provide setup with series, closePriceIndicator, etc. Use NumericIndicator.of(cp1).lowest(barCount) returns NumericIndicator (actually returns NumericIndicator via of(new LowestValueIndicator(this, barCount))). So test that delegate class is LowestValueIndicator and that values are correct.

We need to import needed classes: BarSeries, MockBarSeries, ClosePriceIndicator, NumericIndicator, LowestValueIndicator, etc. Use assertEquals for class type, and assertNumEquals for values (need static import from TestUtils). Since we are using JUnit5, we can use org.ta4j.core.TestUtils.assertNumEquals.

We need to create fields: static Function<Number, Num> numFunction? In existing test class, they have constructor injecting numFunction. But in this test we can just use a default Num implementation via MockBarSeries which requires a numFunction. In repo, they use a static variable defined in AbstractIndicatorTest. To simplify, we can create a MockBarSeries with default number function using DecimalNum::valueOf? Actually Ta4j uses Num interface; there is a DecimalNum implementation. Could use org.ta4j.core.num.DecimalNum; static method DecimalNum.valueOf(double). But MockBarSeries constructor expects Function<Number, Num>. In other tests they use a field numFunction from AbstractIndicatorTest. Since we are not extending that, we can create a Function<Number, Num> using DecimalNum::valueOf.

So in setupBeforeAll we can initialize static Function<Number, Num> numFunction = n -> DecimalNum.valueOf(n.doubleValue()); Then series = new MockBarSeries(numFunction, values...). Then cp1 = new ClosePriceIndicator(series). Then we can use in tests.

Test: NumericIndicator numeric = NumericIndicator.of(cp1); NumericIndicator lowest = numeric.lowest(3); assertTrue(lowest.delegate() instanceof LowestValueIndicator). Also compare values: for each index i from 2 to series.getBarCount()-1 compute expected = new LowestValueIndicator(cp1,3).getValue(i). Compare with lowest.getValue(i). Use assertNumEquals.
